notes: Extracted 31 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/categorycard.guide.tsx, self-contained) and docs/evidence/categorycard.md at 4a044e7 (the 19 October publish of #282 and #283, “Live” on #282). The guide's Sources note and the evidence were checked on 19 October 2026 on 0.1.78-c7d3348 (Biscuit's main at c7d3348, which fixes #282 and #283; first checked 17 October on a116616), so items citing them carry 2026-10-19 and 0.1.78-c7d3348 (same package version as installed, so the trace check does not flag them). Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). GitHub's compare of v0.1.78-c7d3348 and v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (3 commits, 195 files) changes no CategoryCard, Badge, IconCapsule, Image, Text, design-tokens or resolver file; CategoryCard.tsx is the same blob (d097335) at both tags and in node_modules (a116616 had 8700842), Badge.tsx too (b091d4d), IconCapsule.tsx (f4496d2) and Image.tsx (049a31f) are unchanged since a116616, and react-utils.ts, web-platform-utils.ts, typography.ts, figma-variables-resolver.ts and JFSThemeProvider.tsx are the same blobs at both tags. So nothing the 19 October check read has changed. Every guide and evidence sentence quoted here was read against the installed CategoryCard.tsx (read, not rendered; token values through the package's own getVariableByName in lib/commonjs, with the card's own modes): the card sets AppearanceBrand Tertiary, Badge Size Small, Context4 Badge and Radius None over the provider's modes, the caller's modes win, then Card Tab State is forced from active, which beats the mode (lines 40–45, 82–86, 265–279); width defaults to 60 (36, 249); padding 4 all round, gap 6, card radius 8, a 1 px border rgb(245, 245, 245) that turns gold rgb(206, 161, 90) with Card Tab State Active, a white surface in both, a 36 × 36 image, and a 12 px label on a 16 px line, weight 500, rgb(48, 51, 56) (161–220), so the card is 4 + 36 + 6 + 16 + 4 + 2 = 68 px tall, and 74 with the 42 px Icon Capsule (iconCapsule/size 42 under the card's modes); AppearanceBrand, Emphasis and Radius change none of the card's own tokens; Radius reaches only image/radius (None 0, S 8, M 16, L 32), used by the default Image and the plain square, not cardTab/radius, badge/radius or iconCapsule/radius (176, 303–327); the slot gets the card's merged modes through cloneChildrenWithModes, the child's own modes winning (296–301; react-utils.ts 59–66), and imageSlot wins over children (296); with neither slot nor imageSource the card draws a 36 px square in hard-coded #f3f1ec (not a token), hidden from screen readers (37, 315–326); the badge renders only for a non-empty string, in a View placed 11 px above the card's top edge, centred, with maxWidth 38, and Badge truncates its one line with an ellipsis (329–344, 397–407; Badge.tsx 208); every card has marginTop 11, badge or not (356–358); pressed opacity 0.85 unless disabled, disabled 0.5 (222–223, 359–360); the card is always a Pressable with role button, named accessibilityLabel ?? (badge ? `${label}, ${badge}` : label), with accessibilityState selected from active and, on the web, aria-pressed from active (329, 366–381); disabled passes no onPress to the web keyboard handler and tabIndex -1 (331–337; web-platform-utils.ts 283–291); the label Text is hidden from screen readers (385–392); singleLine (default true) keeps the label on one line, nowrap and overflow visible on the web, centred so it spills past both edges, and ignores disableTruncation; singleLine false with disableTruncation true wraps; both false give one line with a tail ellipsis at the card's width (285–294, 350, 409–420; react-utils.ts 216–251). Badge tokens under the card's modes: Tertiary High rgb(2, 107, 154), Primary rgb(206, 161, 90) with a dark label, Secondary rgb(93, 0, 181), Neutral rgb(48, 51, 56); Medium and Low pale fills with a coloured label; Small is 10/12 px with 4/2 padding. Icon Capsule under the card's modes follows AppearanceBrand the same way, and Emphasis Low makes its fill transparent. The registry has every icon the examples use (ic_rupee_coin, ic_loans, ic_savings, ic_insurance, ic_graph_increasing). Tickets, read on the board (read only): #282 (Component Fix, Done, live 19 October) and #283 (Done, live 19 October) are fixed and the installed source confirms both (marginTop 11 on every card, aria-pressed, a plain square in place of the meme; Badge reads Emphasis/badge/high/fg for System High), so neither is a gap. #288 (token problem, Marcin, Components board, To do) is open and still true on dbe0e02: cardTab/label/fontFamily resolves to “Jio Type Var”, against 153 “JioType Var” font tokens in the packaged Coin Variables, and CategoryCard reads it first (181–184), so the first gap names it. The published Storybook was re-read on 31 October (index.json, last modified 31 October): the seven stories the Sources note lists are there, and the docs page, now marked attached-mdx from CategoryCard.mdx, is still the older generated one (its text has “Available Collections and Modes” and no Tabs or ChipSelect), so the Sources sentence still holds and is the third gap. Facts: the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES give AppearanceBrand, Badge Size and Radius their collection defaults (Primary, Medium, S), which the card overrides; evidence facts set the card's own defaults (Tertiary, Small, None) so an agent does not read the collection's. Strength: one quote holds “only”, Radius “rounds the corners of the default image only” (everywhere: Radius reaches the card only through image/radius). Only the label rule is required, on the label fact: left out, the card shows “Popular” (Figma's sample label). avoidWhen rests on the evidence's record of Biscuit's handwritten CategoryCard.mdx (“peers use Tabs, combinable filters use ChipSelect”), as CC Card's entry does; Tabs and Chip Select have entries, so both rules carry useInstead, and their entries agree (Tabs: “a few peer views of the same content”; Chip Select: one filter and whether it is applied). useWhen/2 quotes the same record. Configuration: “The card’s surface, border, and label look the same in every mode.” comes after the section's AppearanceBrand, Emphasis and Radius sentences, so the rule names those three modes; read literally it reaches too far, since Color Mode Dark changes the border (rgb(13, 13, 15)) and the label (rgb(250, 240, 250)) on the still-white surface, and Card Tab State changes the border: reported to the coordinator as a candidate guide fix, not hardened. The AppearanceBrand and Emphasis example captions are kept with their values (the guide's own cards; all hold on dbe0e02); building rules still keep modes at their defaults, so the examples set none. Anatomy required: the Image node and the label are always drawn (a plain square without an image, “Popular” without a label), the Card always; the Badge only with badge. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every card, the VStack, the Title and the HStacks), no Slot gap on the In context VStack, and the guide's CC helper is written out: label, badge, an Icon Capsule with no modes in imageSlot (the card hands it its own) and onPress; the rail's active stands for the screen's selected category, as the guide's useState does. VStack, HStack and Icon Capsule have entries; Title has an undocumented entry. Left out of examples (three at most): the anatomy specimen, the No badge and mode cards, the States cards, the Sizing measure and its 60 px card, the Spills and Wraps cards, the Do & Don'ts and the playground. Not recorded: style and labelStyle (the building rules forbid colour, border, radius and font overrides), accessibilityHint, accessibilityState, webAccessibilityProps, testID and the inherited Pressable props (no guide sentence); the legacy Category Card State mode (source only); Context4 (forced to Badge, changes nothing visible); Semantic Intent System, Badge Size Medium and Color Mode (the guide shows none; building rules); the evidence's hex values, its web render tree and its Hosting note; the Figma layer names, the 60 × 66 Figma size and Code Connect; the label colour difference with Figma (#303338 against black) and the hard-coded placeholder fill (minor; the guide's rule is to give the card a picture). Consistency with related entries: IconCapsule's entry (checked on dbe0e02) agrees: a parent passes its modes to the capsule in its slot and the capsule's own modes win, Emphasis Low is no circle, just the coloured icon, the capsule's colour follows AppearanceBrand, and the tile around it, not the capsule, presses and carries the name. Its default colour (Primary, gold) differs only because the card hands it Tertiary, which this entry says. Badge's entry (checked on 0.1.60) agrees: Badge has no accessibilityLabel of its own, and here the card's name carries the badge; its “Choose Badge Size for the density” is not repeated here, since the card sets Badge Size Small and the guide shows no other size. The package's JSDoc for the card and for badge (carried in the facts) names the badge by a shape word Coin doesn't use; this entry calls it the badge (reported to the coordinator).

      badge="New"
      imageSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_rupee_coin" />}
      active
      onPress={() => {}}
    />
    <CategoryCard
      label="Loans"
      imageSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_loans" />}
      active={false}
      onPress={() => {}}
    />
    <CategoryCard
      label="Savings"
      imageSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_savings" />}
      active={false}
      onPress={() => {}}
    />
    <CategoryCard
      label="Insurance"
      badge="Hot"
      imageSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_insurance" />}
      active={false}
      onPress={() => {}}
    />
  </HStack>
</VStack>

evidenceFacts.name: AppearanceBrand
evidenceFacts.description: CategoryCard sets AppearanceBrand Tertiary over the theme's modes, so Tertiary is its default; modes on the card override it.
evidenceFacts.quote: The card injects `AppearanceBrand: Tertiary`, `Badge Size: Small`, `Context4: Badge`, `Radius: None` (`:38-44`) over the theme's modes; `modes` on the card override them

evidenceFacts.name: Badge Size
evidenceFacts.description: CategoryCard sets Badge Size Small over the theme's modes, so Small is its default; modes on the card override it.
evidenceFacts.quote: The card injects `AppearanceBrand: Tertiary`, `Badge Size: Small`, `Context4: Badge`, `Radius: None` (`:38-44`) over the theme's modes; `modes` on the card override them

evidenceFacts.name: Radius
evidenceFacts.description: CategoryCard sets Radius None over the theme's modes, so None (square corners on the default image) is its default; modes on the card override it.

evidenceFacts.name: accessibilityLabel
evidenceFacts.description: The card is always a Pressable with role button, named by accessibilityLabel, or else by the label, with the badge after a comma when there is one (“Gold, New”).
